items.title: Costco Stock Is Priced For Two Good Years, Is That A Safe Bet?
items.summary: Costco Wholesale (COST) trades at about $928 a share, roughly 43.5 times the last twelve months of adjusted earnings, meaning normalized net income with stock-based compensation added back, a basis meant to sit closer to what analysts use in their forecasts. For a warehouse retailer, that is a growth company's price. What it leaves out is what analysts expect Costco to earn by fiscal 2028.

items.title: Kroger Is Buying Another Grocery Chain While Still in Court Over the Last One
items.summary: Kroger just announced a $1.65 billion grocery acquisition while still fighting its last merger partner in court over the exact same regulatory strategy it plans to use again. The word at the center of both stories is the same, and that is not a coincidence.

items.title: Kroger (KR) Taps Mark Ibbotson To Help Drive Its Store And Digital Shift
items.summary: Kroger (NYSE:KR) has appointed Mark Ibbotson as Executive Vice President and Chief Store Operations Officer. Ibbotson brings extensive experience leading digital transformation and omnichannel operations at Walmart and Asda. The appointment is intended to support Kroger's store operations and omnichannel execution across grocery and pharmacy delivery.
